meta.name: handoff
meta.description: Compact the current conversation into a handoff document for another agent to pick up.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将当前对话压缩为交接文档，供其他智能体继续处理
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在多个智能体之间传递对话上下文
copy.tagline_en: Compact the current conversation into a handoff document for another agent
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to pass conversation context between multiple agents

howto.what: Claude 会把当前对话压缩成一份交接文档,让新的 Agent 能接着干。文档保存到系统临时目录,包含建议调用的技能,并引用已有文件(不重复写内容),还会抹掉 API 密钥、密码等敏感信息。
howto.when: 当你要求把当前对话整理成交接文档,交给另一个 Agent 继续处理时触发。也可以附带说明下一个会话的用途,文档会按此定制。

say.text: 把当前对话整理成交接文档
say.note: 生成文档并保存到临时目录。

say.text: 生成 handoff,下一个会话用于继续写代码
say.note: 会按你指定的用途定制交接内容。

say.text: 总结这次讨论并交接给新 agent
say.note: 文档会包含建议技能和敏感信息脱敏。

howto.what_en: Claude condenses the current conversation into a handoff document for another agent, saved to the OS temp directory. It suggests skills to invoke, references existing artifacts by path/URL, and redacts sensitive info.
howto.when_en: When you ask to compress the current chat into a handoff doc for another agent. Also when you specify the next session's focus, it tailors the doc accordingly.

say_en.text: Turn this conversation into a handoff document.
say_en.note: Saves it to the system temp directory.

say_en.text: Make a handoff; next session will continue the code review.
Summarize and hand off to a fresh agent.
say_en.note: Includes suggested skills and redacts secrets.
